name: Forbes Precision Tools and Machine Parts Ltd

facts.business: Forbes Precision Tools and Machine Parts Limited manufactures and sells high-performance precision round cutting tools, including carbide and high-speed steel (HSS) taps, drills, end mills, thread mills, rotary burrs, and dies for the automotive, engineering, aerospace, defence, railways, and electronics industries under the 'Totem' brand.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Focus on consolidating operations, strengthening core capabilities, and building a scalable platform for sustainable growth; aligning with opportunities across aerospace, defence, railways, and electronics supported by Make in India initiative; channel expansion and targeted international outreach.

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to varied sales contract terms and customer acceptance conditions
Geopolitical developments, evolving trade regimes, and supply chain realignments
Meeting revenue targets and expectations leading to inherent risk of misstatement
